# Fixed Assets

This folder is derived from [billing-accounts-finance.md](../../../billing-accounts-finance.md) and represents a menu or nested menu item. Each non-README Markdown file represents one permanent table leaf menu item.

Folder nesting mirrors **sidebar menu nesting**, not an in-page tab tree. Do not render these levels as a category or nested `AppTabStrip`.

## Leaf menu items

| Menu item | Section slug | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| [Asset Acquisitions](asset-acquisitions.md) | `asset-acquisitions` | Manages the end-to-end asset acquisitions workflow for Fixed Assets. |
| [Asset Categories](asset-categories.md) | `asset-categories` | Maintains the authoritative asset categories records used by Fixed Assets. |
| [Asset Ledger](asset-ledger.md) | `asset-ledger` | Provides a read-oriented asset ledger table for analysis, reconciliation, drill-down, printing, and export without duplicating the authoritative source transactions. |
| [Asset Register](asset-register.md) | `asset-register` | Maintains the authoritative asset register records used by Fixed Assets. |
| [Asset Transfers](asset-transfers.md) | `asset-transfers` | Manages the end-to-end asset transfers workflow for Fixed Assets. |
| [Depreciation Runs](depreciation-runs.md) | `depreciation-runs` | Manages the end-to-end depreciation runs workflow for Fixed Assets. |
| [Disposals](disposals.md) | `disposals` | Manages the end-to-end disposals workflow for Fixed Assets. |
| [Revaluations](revaluations.md) | `revaluations` | Manages the end-to-end revaluations workflow for Fixed Assets. |

## Implementation contract

- Run the [reuse audit](../../_shared/existing-implementation.md) first; most of this scope already exists.
- Every listed leaf menu item is an `AppListTable` worklist or tabular report.
- Forms and workflow actions open from toolbar/row buttons in dialogs.
- Permissions, entitlement, ABAC, human-friendly IDs, export/print, audit, and targeted refresh are mandatory.
- Use the [shared finance contracts](../../_shared/README.md) for tables, dialogs, permissions, API behavior, state, and audit.
